logo.source: Text wordmark in the display face (src/components/Logo.tsx) + src/app/icon.svg
logo.specs: SVG; dark and light versions; square symbol for favicon

typefaces.specs: Special Gothic Expanded One, Special Gothic (Google Fonts)

finalCopy.source: Draft copy in src/config/content.ts, src/config/site.ts and page files — project titles, years, email and social links are placeholders
finalCopy.specs: Written in the recipe voice before layout; headlines ≤ 8 words

yourPhotos.source: 20 stills pulled from your hero film (public/media/stills/)
yourPhotos.usage: Tilted scroll grid — a grid that tilts and flattens in 3d as visitors scroll through it.
yourPhotos.specs: Min 2400px long edge, one consistent grade; keep each photo’s original shape unless the layout says otherwise

heroVideo.specs: 1920×1080 min, 5–15s, slow continuous motion, no text burned in

posterImage.source: prepare-video.sh: first frame of the film
posterImage.usage: Shown before video loads and on reduced motion
posterImage.specs: First frame of the video, same crop

supportingImages.source: Stills from your hero film (same set as yourPhotos)

scrubReadyEncode.specs: Made by scripts/prepare-video.sh from the ORIGINAL file: CRF 20, keyframe every 6 frames, ≤ 1920 px

widescreenVersion.source: Your upload rotated 90° back to landscape (it is a 16:9 film stored sideways) — no crop, no AI expand
widescreenVersion.usage: Desktop and tablet hero — fills 16:9 screens
widescreenVersion.specs: 16:9, 1920×1080 or larger, made from your 720×1280 video. Best: an AI “expand” to 16:9, which keeps every pixel of your video sharp. Otherwise prepare-video.sh crops and upscales it. Phones keep your original.

texture.source: Inline SVG noise in src/config/assets.ts (3.5% opacity)
